summary: Retest completed for UI login persistence and print actions on target vehicle. UI login via مدير/123123 now succeeds without any manual bootstrap (redirected to / and auth_token/session persisted). Sales invoice and diagnosis QuickPrint both exclude supplier item (القرعاوي), show workshop total 600.00 (not 779.00), and invoice preview includes the third-card label 'ملخص المستند'.
